tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// yang 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam pa sna tshogs lo 'dab kyis bkra ze 'bru'i phreng ldan rtsa ba brtan zhing rab rgyas chu skyes lte ba la// mun pa mun nag tshang tshing rab sel chu shel las grub ches 'phro 'bar ba'i ri bong can gyi gdan steng du// kun tu mdzes pa'i sku mnga' gser sbyangs mdog mtshungs lang tsho rab rgyas rin chen gyis spras zur phud lnga dang ldan// mi shes shes mdzad shes rab ral gri utpa la bsnams rdzu 'phrul du mas rab rtsen 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal// gang thugs rang bzhin nam mkha' bzhin du gdod nas rnam dag srid dang zhi la gnyis su med par rtag tu bzhugs kyang*// rnam 'phrul dpag med rin chen las grub sku yi dkyil 'khor smon lam rlung gis dag snang mkha' la legs rgyu zhing*// legs bshad gsung 'od rnam 'phrul du ma'i kha dog gis brgyan skad cig gcig la'ang phyogs phyogs kun tu rab bkye bas// mi shes mun sel shes rab padmo rnam par rgyas byed blo mchog 'jam dbyangs skye dgu'i sgron ma bdag skyabs mchi// sprin bral mkha' la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lhang der gnas ltar gang gis thugs// sgrib gnyis dang bral phyogs las rnam rgyal mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar 'i sku// rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'od kyis gdul bya'i yid 'phrog bcom ldan 'das// dang po'i sangs rgyas gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
